step3.title: Win €10,000
step3.description: Highest score at tournament end wins the grand prize.

q1.question: How do I enter the tournament?
q1.answer: Click 'Enter Tournament', pay €0.50 via Stripe, and you'll be taken to the game. Play once, submit your score with your contact details.

q2.question: Can I play multiple times?
q2.answer: Each €0.50 entry gives you one game. You can enter multiple times, but only your highest score counts toward the leaderboard.

q3.question: How is the winner determined?
q3.answer: The player with the highest verified score when the tournament ends wins the €10,000 prize.

q4.question: Is free play different from tournament play?
q4.answer: Free play lets you practice unlimited times, but your scores won't be recorded and you won't be eligible for the prize.

q5.question: How will I receive my prize?
q5.answer: The winner will be contacted via email within 48 hours of the tournament ending to arrange prize payment.
